description: List the signed-in user's client and internal time entries for one work date in the active organization. Client rows include an accessible matter; internal rows have no matter. Follow the cursor for the next page. Logged minutes, daily target and remaining minutes cover all accessible entries for the date, independently of pagination. Logged minutes sum client and internal durations; target and remaining minutes are null when no target is set.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous page to fetch the next page
